scope: Allow a governed dependency revision to proceed when the only remaining runtime fence is a retained worker_worktrees lease that is provably inactive allocation/provenance metadata, without weakening any other existing dependency-contract fence

observed_baseline.reason: The existing scripts/ai_status.py:5064 _dependency_contract_runtime_fence unconditionally raised DependencyContractBusy('affected task has a worktree lease') for any retained worker_worktrees.leases record naming an affected task, even though the probe found no active worker, no unsettled queue event, no off-lock reservation, and an already-settled/held worker_recovery pointer for that same task.
observed_baseline.probe_reference: /tmp/dependency_inactive_workspace_probe.json probes[0] ("actual inactive BFF retained allocation", verdict busy, reason "affected task has a worktree lease")

implementation.distinction: A retained lease for an affected task no longer fences the revision by mere presence. It must pass every correlated signal: exact task_id/workspace_task_id identity match, every lease identity field (branch, path, status_root, source_root, repository_id, base_ref, base_sha, last_used_at) present as a nonblank string, a last_queue_event_id that resolves to an existing queue event whose status is exactly 'completed', and the task's own worker_recovery must already pass the existing _dependency_contract_validate_worker_recovery settled/held contract unchanged.
implementation.fail_closed_default: Any missing/blank identity field, an identity mismatch, an unresolved or non-completed queue-event correlation, or a task-side worker_recovery that is pending/reassigned/malformed/unknown/future-generation still raises DependencyContractBusy('affected task has a worktree lease') or the existing pending-recovery reason, exactly as before this change
implementation.preserved_fences: Active-worker, queue-intent, off-lock phase reservation, malformed-runtime-record, and privileged/catalog checks are untouched; the worker and queue loops still run and can still raise before the worktree loop is reached for the same task
implementation.no_mutation_of_runtime: The dependency-contract command still never writes runtime_state; only the canonical task row's depends_on/dependency_tracks/generation/contract_revision/last_update change on commit
implementation.no_new_mechanism: No lease-release command, new API, scheduler, or task-state authority was added; scripts/ai_status.py and scripts/test_ai_status.py are the only granted implementation files touched

new_regression_cases.asserts: Every ambiguous or active signal still fails closed with exit 75 and no canonical/runtime mutation: blank or missing lease identity fields (each of the 8 fields individually), a workspace_task_id identity mismatch, an unsettled (non-completed) correlated queue event, a missing/dangling last_queue_event_id, a real active worker for the task even with an otherwise well-formed lease, a real off-lock phase reservation for the task even with an otherwise well-formed lease, and a task-side worker_recovery that is still pending even though the lease itself is well-formed and correlated
